transcript: Driver: Sir, sarkar ke baare me kya khayal hai aapka? Haanji? [Sir, what is your opinion about the government? Yes?] Passenger: Bhaiya, bas ek second. [Brother, just a second.] Passenger (whispering): Hey team, two things we need to do today: We need to get the updated presentation. The demo needs to be way funnier. Driver: Dekh rahe ho sir, road kitne badhiya ban gaye hain. Chand pe jaane ki zarurat hi nahi hai hume. Batao sir. [See sir, how good the roads have become. We don't even need to go to the moon. Tell me, sir.]
on_screen_text: Sir, sarkar ke baare me kya khayal hai aapka? Haanji? Bhaiya, bas ek second. Hey team, Dekh rahe ho sir, road kitne badhiya ban gaye hain. Chand pe jaane ki zarurat hi nahi hai hume. Batao sir. Hey team, two things we need to do today: 1. We need to get the updated presentation 2. The demo needs to be way funnier. Catches your whispers. Wispr Flow. Ready for India and the World. Download today at wisprflow.ai. Android, Windows, iOS, Mac.
summary: A passenger in a noisy auto-rickshaw successfully dictates a message using Wispr Flow despite a chatty driver and loud engine noise. The app accurately transcribes his whispered voice notes. Viewers are invited to download the app on multiple platforms.
